item.title: Sony a7V Focusing Errors with Some Lenses: Explained
item.description: It finally happened, after a long weekend of shooting with the Sony a7V and both Viltrox and Sony lenses, the purple autofocus error flashed on screen and rendered the camera inoperable for a few power cycles. This issue is similar to one reported when using third-party lenses, but it was the first time I experienced it with Sony’s own lenses. Is this evidence of a bigger issue with the release of Sony’s new entry-level camera?

item.title: Aiarty Image Matting: The Photo Background Remover That Nails Intricate Pictures
item.description: Background removal used to be a niche task reserved for commercial retouchers. Today, it’s rapidly becoming part of every photographer’s workflow, from portrait shooters delivering clean composites to product photographers producing consistent catalog images. Whether you’re working on client campaigns, wedding galleries, social content, or high-end composites, having a reliable photo background remover has become as essential as having a good RAW processor.
